name: Fit Mom Trader
show: Fit Mom Trader · LIVE Day Trading
streamSlot: Mon–Thu · live NY-session streams (NQ & ES) · trades Asia/Tokyo evenings · Fridays off
tagline: The boring 60-minute Initial Balance system — two setups, $200 fixed risk, two losses and done — that took a gym-owning mom of three from blowing accounts to $165K of prop payouts.
summary: Krista (Fit Mom Trader, Krista Fudge) is a futures day trader and mom of three who traded NQ ~95% of the time through one 'bread and butter' range: the New York 9:30–10:30 ET Initial Balance, played only as a failed auction at the extremes or a trend continuation off the IB mid/VWAP. She streams live Monday–Thursday, trades the Asia session in the evening (often gold), and pairs the system with fixed small risk, a 2-loss daily stop, alert-based entries and hard account lockouts. Her six-figure 2026 prop payouts came from boring repetition of that one range.
oneLiner: Mark the 9:30–10:30 NY Initial Balance; long or short only the failed auction back inside the range or the trend continuation off the IB mid; $200 risk per trade, 2 losses max, alerts instead of screen time.
keyQuote: My best setup wins about 70% of the time.
keyQuoteSource: "my trading strategy is boring, but it made me $100,000 in 2 months" (YouTube, Oct 26, 2026)
highlights: One range, two setups: the 9:30–10:30 ET Initial Balance is her 'bread and butter' — 'it's like a 60 minute ORB'; failed auction at the extremes or trend continuation off the IB mid.
Day-type selects the setup: trending days get IB-mid retracements; choppy days get failed auctions — 'you can adjust to the market conditions.'
Risk is mechanical: $200 fixed per trade, contracts sized from the stop distance, daily loss limit of 2 losses 'then stop' (her 50K-account, $2K-drawdown example).
Alert-based execution: 'if my alert doesn't go off, then I don't trade' — plus the lockout button: 'it protects my profits, my mental capital, and my time.'
NQ over ES ~95% of the time; micros (MNQ) to pass evals and protect capital; Asia/Tokyo evening book (18:00–20:00 ET range, gold/MGC) targeting ~3R.
No-trade conditions are explicit: choppy/flat-VWAP days, the last NY hour, lunch/holiday chop, CPI/PPI/FOMC/NFP days, and anything after the daily loss limit.
